turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with the zero on Owen's essay. Who decided to enter it, and why did I find out from my son's phone?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
Okay. You didn't answer my question, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. I'm not here for compliments. I want the zero withdrawn and an apology, and if I don't get both, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here, Hale? You've said two kind things and nothing about the zero. I'm writing down that you still haven't told me what you based it on.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
"Work this out together." That's not a position, Hale. Tell me what you have on Owen's essay, or I'm going upstairs.
